_meta.run: design-critic prompt (.claude/agents/design-critic.md) executed by a Sonnet general-purpose subagent (the custom agent is not registered mid-session); blind: sheet + metrics only; design-1 = Adam CAD v0 meshes, design-2 = sample_sleek_050 smooth massing

reads_as_reason: Smooth, human-proportioned and clearly not a toy, but one seamless grey mannequin with no shell/recess separation, no visor-style head, and no joint detail.

G1.evidence: Adult proportions with a small capsule head (P1 0.133 H), narrow waist, long legs, small foot. No chibi head, no box torso. Caveat: squared upper chest and flat shoulder tops; mannequin read.

G2.evidence: Chest to waist to pelvis and thigh to shank flow, but the shoulder caps are separate tubes off a flat-topped chest block with a visible ledge; the pelvis/thigh top bulges as a kink; no deliberate dark joint recesses anywhere.

G3.evidence: One uniform clay surface; a single watertight part (M1 1/1), so no geometry for dark recesses or a shell/under-structure split.

G4.evidence: Limbs, head and legs share soft rounding; the chest is squarer than the capsule limbs and the shoulder caps use a tighter radius; contour banding limits the judgement.

G6.evidence: At equal height the silhouette sits very close to both references (S2 IoU 0.756 / 0.775). Differs: hip/thigh flare wider, shoulders step out more abruptly, head fuller and shorter-necked.

pairwise.evidence: Image A (candidate) is a continuous, human-proportioned form close to the reference silhouettes. Image B (baseline) is stacked boxes: a floating small head on a thin stub neck, huge square shoulder blocks, a gapped waist band, slab thighs, boot-like feet with a protruding base plate, and exposed white gaps in the silhouette. The baseline reads as a toy or Lego-style robot.

top_changes.change: Remove the hip/thigh bulge and the abrupt shoulder ledge; round and lower the shoulder cap into a sloped shoulder line.
Create a deliberate dark under-structure read: pronounced neck/waist groove and narrow joint waists at shoulder, elbow, hip and knee.
Make the chest section rounder, in line with the limbs and head.

notes: Judged from clay views and silhouettes only; numbers quoted from the metrics JSON; contour banding on torso/thighs limits G4.
